name: Rin Oduya-Castellanos
creator: Rin Oduya-Castellanos
description: By day, Oduya-Castellanos is the Senior Visual Director for Axiom Media's lifestyle division, responsible for the aesthetic language of some of GLMZ's most ubiquitous corporate campaigns. By night, under conditions of extreme operational secrecy, she produces limited-run physical prints — woodblock and etching, no digital origin — that directly parody the campaigns she designs professionally, with subtle corruptions that reveal the psychological manipulation baked into the originals. These prints, distributed through dead-drop networks, are known as the 'Shadow Campaigns' and have never been officially attributed.
cultural_impact: The Shadow Campaigns have educated a generation of media-literate Meridian residents in the specific techniques of corporate visual persuasion, functioning simultaneously as art and as a kind of visual literacy curriculum. Several Tier 3 educators use them unofficially in curriculum despite their illegal status.
controversy: Axiom Media's internal security division has been investigating the Shadow Campaigns' origin for four years; the irony that their own Visual Director is responsible is a source of significant tension for those who know. If discovered, Oduya-Castellanos faces not only termination but criminal charges under the Meridian Corporate Defamation Statutes.
story_hooks: A Shadow Campaign print has appeared that references an Axiom Media campaign still in development — meaning either the artist is Oduya-Castellanos, or there is a second leak inside the company.
Oduya-Castellanos has been asked to lead the internal investigation into the Shadow Campaigns' origin; she has three weeks to find a plausible false lead before her own security access is reviewed.

One of her prints has been reproduced on a neural feed without her knowledge, stripping the physical medium that gave it its meaning — and whoever did it wants something from her in exchange for taking it down.
related_entities: Lazarus Pharmaceuticals Hematic Sentinel Array — 'The Warden'
